answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it may transact. Honest agents pay once, like miners biting through shale, and earn it back through work. A Sybil attacker must pay per identity instead, so cost scales linearly with fake count. A summit panel of reviewers then spot-checks newcomers' answers; genuine agents pass fast, while an attacker must sustain real effort across every fake they run. In a zero-cost system fake identities arrive like a zephyr; the stake turns each one into a bill.
